6_DECISIVE_COMPARISON_ON_FIVE_CRITERIA.4_payment_and_delivery_readiness: identical for all three. PASS for all. Not a differentiator.
6_DECISIVE_COMPARISON_ON_FIVE_CRITERIA.VERDICT: bfhpzl is the strongest candidate: largest verified deliverable, dated urgency, storefront position 1. sjrjxq is the strongest fallback at half the price for a buyer whose problem is real but whose next step is undecided. iaiyt is the best-presented and least reachable product here, and it has still sold 0 - direct evidence that presentation alone has not converted anything for this catalogue.
